text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The members of Little Lyrical had gathered in
the streets of Landosol and were on their way
to their secret base.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの街に集合した【リトルリリカル】たちは、
秘密基地へ向かおうとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm, hmm~♪ Hey, hey! What should we do
after we study at the secret base?! Maybe
Misogi should engineer a new trap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんふんふ～ん♪
ねぇねぇ！　
秘密基地で勉強したあと、
どうする！？
ミソギは新しい罠でも作ろっかな！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be reading a new book. There's
no cold drafts in there anymore, so I won't
have to worry about my hands getting numb.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は本を読んでるよ。
すきま風がないから、
手がかじかんで動かない……
なんて心配もなくなったしね。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
As for Mimi~ I'm going to water the flowers
with Petit Griffon-san♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミはね～
プチグリフォンさんといっしょに
お花に水をあげるんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Housewife 1
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard about it? The story of that
band of thieves that came from abroad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう聞いたかしら？
国外から来たっていうあの盗賊団の話！

text_block_list.name: Housewife 2
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE have
finally found their hideout, haven't they?
...But I heard that there's a remnant of them
still around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】が
ようやくアジトを突き止めたんですよね。
……でも、
まだ残党が逃げ回ってるって聞きましたけど。

text_block_list.name: Housewife 1
text_block_list.text:
Seems like it. Well, no matter where they go,
the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE keep their
eyes peeled nowadays, so they'll be
eventually caught...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうみたいねぇ。
まぁ、
今はどこへ行っても
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】が目を光らせてるし、
見つかるのは時間の問題でしょうけど……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Bandits... So that's why there's been so many
incidents lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
盗賊団……
だから最近、
事件が多かったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's hurry to the secret
base! Alright! Let's race to see who gets
there first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
早く秘密基地に行こう！
よーし！　
誰が最初にたどり着くか、
競争だー！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Ah, WAAAAAAAAAAIT...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
まって～～……！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Misogi's the first to get in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーい！
ミソギが一番乗り──

text_block_list.name: Petit Griffon
text_block_list.text: Pfffft!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷっぷー！！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Wah?!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Petit Griffon-san...? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
プチグリフォンさん……？
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Petit Griffon
text_block_list.text: Pfft...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷぷー……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? At the secret base... there's someone
we don't know...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
秘密基地に知らない人がいるの……？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Someone we don't know? ...Who could it be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らない人？
……誰だろう？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: ...Let's sneak a peek. Come here, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……こっそりのぞいてみよう。
二人ともこっち来て！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We're going...? Umm, umm... Petit
Griffon-san you... hide here, okay...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
行くの……？
ええと、
ええと……
プチグリフォンさんはここで隠れててね……！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text:
Boss. Looks like some brats' playground. I
think we'll be safe here for a while...
text_block_list.orig_text:
親父。
どうやらガキの遊び場のようです。
ここならしばらく安全じゃないかと……

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Safe? The top dog of the Royal Knights of
NIGHTMARE is after us! There ain't no safe
place left!
text_block_list.orig_text:
安全？
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の親玉に睨まれたんだ！
安全な場所なんざどこにもねぇよ！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
And the reason for that is... OI, YOU
BASTARDS!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もとはといえばなぁ。
おい、
てめぇ！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text: うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Pickpocketing wallets like a damn idiot!
That's how they found out it was the work of
a gang of thieves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカみたいに財布をスリやがって！
おかげで盗賊団の仕業だってバレたんだろうが！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
And you got taken down by three little
brats!? I shouldn't've saved a spineless
loser like you! Come to think of it... you
weren't the only one who got caught, were
you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもガキ３人組にやられただぁ！？
そんな腑抜け、
助けるんじゃなかったぜ！
そういや、
やられたのはおめぇだけじゃなかったな……

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: Eek...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ
……！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Your uselessness got our underlings arrested!
And you're the reason our hideout got
exposed! And one last thing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
てめぇが無能なせいで、
下っ端が捕まったんだろうが！
アジトの場所がバレたのも、
そのせいに決まってる！
最後に……

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... I haven't actually done anything
yet, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……
俺はまだなにもしていませんが……

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, you're all so pathetic I even lost
the will to yell... Why am I left solely with
all the useless bastards...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそ、
情けなくて怒鳴る気も失せたぜ……
なんで残ったのがこんな役立たずばっかなんだ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Those are... the bad guys we dealt with the
other day. So they are the "remnants" who ran
away we heard about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれって、
この間こらしめた悪い奴らだよね。
『逃げた残党』ってあいつらだったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That huge, bear-like guy in the
middle... There's no doubt about it... the
"Great Demon Lord" really exists. We have to
hurry and tell the adults...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
きっと
あの真ん中にいる熊みたいな大男……
絶対、
間違いない……
『大魔王』が本当にいたなんて。
はやく大人たちに知らせにいこう……！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wait...! They're coming this way...! We
have to hide...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ、
待って……！
こっちに来るよぉ……！　
隠れなきゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? I thought I heard voices, but maybe I
was worrying too much. Hey, you guys. We're
leaving this country. Take everything from
that tent that looks like it could be worth
money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
話し声がすると思ったが、
気にし過ぎか。
おい、
おめぇら。
この国から出るぞ。
そのテントから金になりそうなモン全部運べ。

text_block_list.name: ３人
text_block_list.text: えっ！？
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text:
Boss! There's something that looks like a
bomb in here. Do you want to take this with
you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
親父！　
爆弾らしきものがありますが、
これも持っていきますか？

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Why would a kid have something like that?
...Well, whatever. Take it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでガキがそんなの持ってんだ？
……
まぁいい。
もってけ。

text_block_list.name: ミソギ
text_block_list.text:
ああっ！　
ミソギが作った爆弾たち！
あいつら！　
……ってダメダメ。
ここはがまん、
がまん……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！　
ミソギが作った爆弾たち！
あいつら！　
……ってダメダメ。
ここはがまん、
がまん……！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text:
Boss. I only found books for children
inside...
text_block_list.orig_text:
親父。
子供向けの本しかありませんけど……

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Take anything that you can turn into cash,
even if it's just a pittance!
text_block_list.orig_text: 雀の涙でも換金できそうなもんはもってけ！

text_block_list.name: キョウカ
text_block_list.text:
それは
お小遣いを貯めて買った本なのに……！
でもミソギだって耐えたんだから。
がまん、
がまん……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは
お小遣いを貯めて買った本なのに……！
でもミソギだって耐えたんだから。
がまん、
がまん……！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Boss... I don't think we'd have any use
for those flower seeds...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと
親父……
お花の種なんてさすがに持っていきませんよね……

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
DON'T MAKE ME REPEAT MYSELF! Just take
everything out already!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何度も言わせんな！
いいから全部根こそぎもってけ！！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Mimi's precious flower seeds... Mimi has to
hold back, too... *sniff*
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミの
大事なお花の種……
ミミも、
がまんしないと……
くすん。

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
I've packed everything onto the cart. ...It's
all junk, but I think these frilly ribbons
will sell for a lot of money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全部荷台に詰め込んだな。
……
どれもガラクタばっかだが、
このヒラヒラしたリボンは高く売れそうじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダ
メー！！！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
That's the ribbons Nii-chan bought for Misogi
and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text: それはにいちゃんがミソギたちに買ってくれたリボンだよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
That's the one thing we absolutely,
ABSOLUTELY can't give you!
text_block_list.orig_text: それだけはぜったいぜったい渡せません！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... G-Give them back to Mimi and the
others...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くすん……
ミ、
ミミたちに返して……！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: AHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ
ーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text:
Boss! It's them! The brats who got in the way
of my work!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
親父！　
あいつらですよ！
俺の仕事を邪魔したガキは！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text: Boss! Same here! It's them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
親父！　
俺もそうです！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... we're dealing with a child here...
You're not going to do anything rough, are
you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でも。
相手は子供ですし……
さすがに
手荒な真似はしませんよね？

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
What the hell are you talking about?! We're
going to make them pay for humiliating us!
You guys! Get 'em!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに言ってやがる！
俺たちをコケにしやがった落とし前はきっちりつけてやる！
おめぇら！　
捕まえろ！！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: RIGHT!
text_block_list.orig_text: へいっ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You two! Let's escape towards that village!
Eigh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人ともあっちの村へ逃げよう！
えいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?
text_block_list.orig_text: うわっ！？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text: T-They vanished...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
消えた……？

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Like hell they did! Go after them!! RIGHT
NOW!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなわけあるか！
今すぐ追え！！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: Okay...!
text_block_list.orig_text: へい……！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text:
They said they were going to run off to "that
village". We'll get there first and catch
'em. The village... which way is it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつら、
『あっちの村』へ逃げるとかって言ってたな。
先回りしてとっ捕まえるぞ。
村は……
どっちだ！？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text:
We're not from here, so there's no way we'd
know. Let's see... We can probably tell just
by looking at the signs. ...Okay, follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここの人間じゃねぇんだから
そんなこと知るわけねぇだろ。
ええとそうだな……
標識見りゃわかんだろ。
……
よし、
ついてこい！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 1
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! No matter how you look at it, this
isn't a village!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………おい！
どう考えてもここは村じゃねぇだろうが！！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 2
text_block_list.text:
LIKE I DON'T KNOW! I JUST FOLLOWED THE
SIGNS!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
知るか！
俺は標識通りに来たんだぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Bandits
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAA!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎ
ゃー！！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! The prank was a huge success! ...Wait,
what? Did I rewrite this sign? Or was it
already like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへーん！　
イタズラ大成功！
……ってあれ？
この標識、
書き換えたっけ？　
元のままだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
You didn't change that one. You changed the
sign before it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その標識は書き換えてないよ。
書き換えたのはその前の標識。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: How do you even know that?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしてそんなこと分かるの！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Because I wrote it down. Honestly, Misogi...
Don't you remember? We did the exact same
thing before and all got lost.
text_block_list.orig_text:
メモしたからね。
も～
ミソギ。
前にも同じことやって、
３人で迷子になったこと、
覚えてないの？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Is that so? But thanks to you, we're
saved, Kyouka! ...Wait, where's Mimi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～
そうだったけ？
でもキョウカのおかげで助かったよ！
……ってあれ？　
ミミは？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mimi's not here?! I thought she was
right behind us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
ミミがいない！？
一緒に来てると思ってたのに！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me a bad guy caught her?! Let's
hurry back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
悪いヤツに捕まった！？
急いで戻ろう！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should we do...? I was so focused on
taking notes... If only I'd been watching
behind us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう……
メモをとるのに必死で……
私が後ろもちゃんと見てれば……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then Misogi too... I ran
off without telling either of you...
A-Anyway... let's search for her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならミソギだって……
二人に言わずに、
勝手なことしたから……
……と、
とにかく探そう！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Okay~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Wah?!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you two okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
だいじょうぶ……？

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Mimi!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ミミ！！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Y-You two... it hurts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ……！
ふ、
二人とも苦しいよぉ……！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Please bear it! We were really worried!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がまんして！
ほんとに心配したんだから！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm gonna keep hugging you
tight so we never get separated again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ！
また離れないように、
ずっとぎゅ～～ってしてやるー！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I got chased by a different
man on the way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんね……
とちゅうで
ちがうおじさんに追いかけられちゃったの……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What happened to that old man?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
そのおじさんはどうしたの！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Did you shake him off?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 振り切ったの！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Well, um... about that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
そのね……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A while ago──
text_block_list.orig_text: 少し前──

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm scared...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う
ぅ……
こわいよぉ……！

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...! I-It's fine! I won't get any closer,
so come on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……っ！　
だ、
大丈夫だ……！
これ以上近づかないから、
ほらな……？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: ...Fweh?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふぇ？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah. Of course you're scared... that's
only natural... I never thought he'd go as
far as trying to sell off someone this
small... This isn't a joke...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そ、
そうだよな。
怖くて当たり前だよな……
あの人もまさか、
こんな小さな子供まで売ろうなんて……
冗談じゃないよ……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...Old man, aren't you friends with those
scary people?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おじさん、
あのこわい人たちのおともだちじゃないの？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanted to be friends with
them... If I could, I'd quit... I really
would... *sigh* All because of a stupid
debt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お友達になりたくて、
なったわけじゃないんだよ……
できればやめたいんだけどね……
はぁ、
借金したばっかりにこんな……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...A debt? So you need money...? Then... can
you use Mimi's money...? Here... take it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しゃっきん？　
お金がいるの……？
それなら、
ミミのお金、
つかえる……？
はい、
これ……

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where did you get this...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
これは、
どうしたんだい……？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
When I help Mommy, she gives me an allowance.
Mimi saved up a whole lot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかあさんのお手伝いをするとね、
おこづかいもらえるんだ。
ミミね、
たくさんためたの。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Old man... if you got this, would you
stop...? Can you stop doing bad things... and
be good again...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさん、
これがあれば、
やめられる……？
悪いことしないで、
よくなる……？

text_block_list.name: Subordinate 3
text_block_list.text: Young lady...
text_block_list.orig_text: お嬢ちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...And that's what happened. Then he told me,
"You can run now". And he gave this back,
too. Here you go♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ってことがあったの。
そしたらおじさんが
『にげていいよ』って。
あと、
これも返してくれたの。
はい、
どーぞ♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: It's our ribbons!
text_block_list.orig_text: ミソギたちのリボンだ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Mimi. Alright -- let's get out of
this forest and call for help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうミミ。
そうだ、
はやくこの森を出て助けを呼ぼう！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get away!
text_block_list.orig_text: 逃がすか！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: UWAH!?
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: T-The "Great Demon Lord"...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
『大魔王』……！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Fueen... I'm scared...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぇえん……
こわいよぉ……！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Th-Throwing an axe?! You could've hit Misogi
and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
斧を投げつけるなんて……
ミソギたちに当たったら危ないじゃんか！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, you rotten brats! Don't think an
apology's gonna save you! I'll teach you
exactly what happens when you mess with
adults!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせぇ！　
この悪ガキどもめ！
ごめんなさいで済むと思うなよ！
大人をなめたらどうなるか、
たっぷり思い知らせてやる！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
T-Take this... Misogi's Surprise Ball!
EIGH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミ、
ミソギのビックリボールをくらえ！　
えい！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text: HAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: せりゃっ！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Misogi's Surprise Ball... It got split right
in half...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギのビックリボール……
真っ二つになっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll use my magic... EEEEIGH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら私の魔法で……
ええいっ！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to freeze me? An attack like
that doesn't even hurt. HMPH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか俺を氷漬けにしようってか？
こんな攻撃、
痛くもかゆくもねぇな。
ふんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: No way...!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな……！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text:
Are you done already? Then next... it's my
turn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう終わりか？
なら次は……
俺の番だ。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Mi-Mimi is the biggest girl...! Therefore
Mimi... has to protect you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミ、
ミミはおねえさんだもん……！
だから、
二人はミミが守らなくちゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
...N-No such thing! I want to protect you
too, Mimi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そ、
そんなの私だって！
私もミミのこと、
守りたい！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Misogi feels the same! I'll definitely be
right next to you, Mimi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギも！
絶対、
ミミの隣にいる！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Could this be...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: これってもしかして！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: It's definitely his power! But how...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対あの人の力だよ！
でもどうして……？

text_block_list.name: Petit Griffon
text_block_list.text: Pfffft!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷっぷー！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at the sky! Petit Griffon-san
brought Onii-chan here! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
お空を見て！
プチグリフォンさんが、
おにいちゃんを連れてきてくれたんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text: ORYAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おりゃああっ！！

text_block_list.name: キョウカ
text_block_list.text:
怖いけど……
でも
みんなと一緒なら
『大魔王』だって倒せるよ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖いけど……
でも
みんなと一緒なら
『大魔王』だって倒せるよ！

text_block_list.name: ミソギ
text_block_list.text:
だってミソギたちがそろえば、
さいきょーだもん！
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってミソギたちがそろえば、
さいきょーだもん！

text_block_list.name: ミミ
text_block_list.text:
おにいちゃん、
見てて……
ミミたちがんばるから……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん、
見てて……
ミミたちがんばるから……！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: やぁあああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Head of the Bandits
text_block_list.text: Guaaaahhh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐぁああああ！！

text_block_list.name: Petit Griffon
text_block_list.text: Pfffft!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷっぷー！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Why are we... lying on the ground...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たち、
なんで倒れてるんだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nii-chan's here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
にいちゃんがいる。

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: UWAH!?
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Geez~ Nii-chan! If you squeeze us that tight,
we can't breathe~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう～
にいちゃん！
そんなにぎゅっとされたら苦しいよ～～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Awawawa...! Pervert! Suspicious pervert!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわわわ……！
へんたいです！　
ふしんしゃです！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: ...Onii-chan. Sorry for making you worry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おにいちゃん。
心配かけて、
ごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's why you're making that
face... But thanks to you, Misogi and the
others are not hurt at all! See?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええと
そっか……
だからそんな顔して……
にいちゃんのおかげで、
ミソギたち怪我してないから！　
ほら！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I may have said too much just now... I'm
sorry for worrying you... ...I was really
relieved when you came, {0}-san. I
really mean it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
言い過ぎました……
心配かけてすみません……
……{0}さんが来てくれて、
安心しました。
本当ですよ……？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! By the way, what happened to the
"Great Demon Lord"?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！
そういえば『大魔王』はどうなりましたか！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! He's sprawled out over there! Heheh! We
beat him together! Little Lyrical really is
the strongest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！　
あそこで伸びてるよ！
へへっ！　
みんなでやっつけたんだ！
やっぱり【リトルリリカル】はさいきょーだね！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah... we really are the best♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
さいきょーだね♪

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Eheheh♪
text_block_list.orig_text: えへへっ♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Until reinforcements from the Royal Knights
of NIGHTMARE arrived, the three girls
snuggled close in {0}'s arms,
pressing their cheeks together and smiling
happily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の応援が駆けつけるまでの間、
{0}の腕の中で、
３人は頬っぺたを寄せ、うれしそうに笑いあうのだった。
